Results from live programmes.

Health insurance · General insurer

Mega Insurance

38% more claims finalised per day, with the same analysts.

Challenge

A growing volume of health claims, mostly outpatient, reviewed by a small team on the previous claims system.

What we did

Every claim is read, checked against the policy and tariffs, and flagged for medical relevance. The insurer's analysts approve each decision.

Scale

73,700+

billed items checked across 17,800+ claims, every one reviewed, not a sample.

  • 67 → 92claims finalised per working day
  • 14 → 7days for the slowest claims
  • 34 → 23staff minutes per claim
  • 92%finalised within 7 days

Health insurance · Claims through a TPA

Takaful Keluarga with Medilink

18% more overpayment caught than the year before.

Challenge

Monthly claim intake nearly tripled during the year, while every item still needed a check against the policy and clinical guidelines.

What we did

Every billed item is checked against clinical guidelines, the policy and the insurer's past findings. Medilink's analysts make every approval decision.

Scale

76,000+

billed items checked across 11,300+ claims, with 92% processed end to end by the AI.

  • 14.4% → 17.1%of claim value identified as not payable
  • 92%of claims fully processed by the AI
  • ~3×monthly claim volume handled as intake grew
